items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: The man's name was Shep Kelly, but everybody called it -- well, I went to

ctx.x: What was Kelly's? Was that there? You just mentioned the name.

No. The Kelly's that I mentioned, when I said Shep Kelly, but this was the man's name. This man's name was Shep Kelly that I was thinking about. He used to have a little place on Ivar, right across the street from the Knickerbocker Hotel, and the place was called Kelly's. The man's name was Shep Kelly, but everybody called it -- well, I went to

work there, and I guess I worked there for about a year, and I met an awful lot of people, and some of the stars used to come in that place, you know, and I enjoyed it. I just loved it. I was doing a single there, you know.
